name: Biak Kota

queries.query: Biak Kota Indonesia official cadastral parcel map ATR BPN
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official BHUMI interactive map and ATLAS geospatial portal. Search results also evidenced the Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Biak Numfor as the local land-office custodian, but no Biak Kota-specific public parcel endpoint or safe anonymous feature response was identified.

queries.query: Biak Kota peta bidang tanah resmi ATR BPN; Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Biak Numfor layanan peta bidang tanah resmi
queries.result: Pencarian berbahasa Indonesia menemukan portal resmi BHUMI/ATLAS ATR/BPN dan bukti publik mengenai Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Biak Numfor sebagai custodian lokal. Tidak ditemukan layanan publik khusus Biak Kota dengan respons anonim yang memuat identitas bidang tanah asli dan geometri aman.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Biak Numfor is evidenced as the local land-office custodian by official/regulatory and public institutional references, but its Biak Kota parcel-vector coverage and public endpoint were not verified.
regionalOrNationalSources: BHUMI ATR/BPN official help says the interactive map disseminates spatial information and includes land-parcel map elements.
ATLAS is the official ATR/BPN geospatial portal; its public catalog was reachable, but no Biak Numfor/Biak Kota parcel layer or anonymous feature response was exposed.
The Kabupaten Biak Numfor government site is general administrative information and is not parcel-vector evidence.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: A local land-office custodian is evidenced, but no usable Biak Kota registry/map/procedure with safe parcel geometry and stable native identity was identified; registryFound remains null.
